a C$10M bought-deal private placement, led by ATB Cormark Capital Markets as sole bookrunner.
The company will issue 15.38M common shares at C$0.65 per share.
Underwriters have an option to increase the offering by up to C$1.5M, bringing potential gross proceeds to about C$11.5M.
Net proceeds will fund exploration and advancement of the El Dorado Monserrat Project in Argentina, along with general corporate and working-capital needs.
